source.description:
## PROBLEM
The next patch release must accurately describe all consumer-visible work since v3.18.1 without publishing a minor version. Current [Unreleased] omits merged work, and an older changelog scrub task remains open.

## SUCCESS
A release-ready, policy-conformant [Unreleased] block exists for v3.18.2; the historical scrub is resolved; and release preflight explicitly records publication blockers and verification evidence.

## SCRUTINY
none

## SCOPE
CHANGELOG.md; commits and PRs in v3.18.1..HEAD; .xtrm/reports when present; existing bead unitAI-61tqz; package metadata, release tags, CI/npm preflight evidence.

## NON_GOALS
No source/config edits, version bump, build, commit, tag, push, GitHub release, or npm publish in this task.

## CONSTRAINTS
Use changelog-conventions and changelog-keeper-scope. Keep the requested release as v3.18.2. Reconcile the same-file historical scrub before integrating the new Unreleased edit. Preserve consumer-visible history; do not invent entries.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Audit maps every v3.18.1..HEAD PR/commit to include, omit, or existing changelog coverage with evidence.
- [ ] Changelog update is limited to CHANGELOG.md and passes diff --check.
- [ ] The Unreleased sections are in Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, Deprecated, Security order with one-line entries.
- [ ] Release preflight verifies clean permitted scope, npm auth/version, package version, and required PR checks.

## OUTPUT
Audit matrix, exact proposed changelog bullets, historical-scrub result, release blocker list, and a go/no-go for v3.18.2.
source.notes: Verified release historical blocker is already resolved in current CHANGELOG: v3.18.0 tag has the Mercury detail, current entries are generic. Removed stale blocks edge from release-note fill; unitAI-61tqz remains owned by dawid for board cleanup.

source.description:
## PROBLEM
changelog-drafter is declared READ_ONLY but also declares Bash as a required tool. Runtime pre-run validation rejects that combination, so the intended release-audit specialist cannot start.

## SUCCESS
changelog-drafter can perform its documented read-only release-bundle audit without failing capability/permission validation.

## SCRUTINY
high

## SCOPE
config/specialists/changelog-drafter.specialist.json; applicable schema/validation tests; its documented read-only command surface.

## NON_GOALS
No changelog edits, release operations, permission broadening beyond what a genuinely read-only audit needs, or unrelated specialist changes.

## CONSTRAINTS
Preserve least privilege. Prefer removing/replacing the incompatible declared tool over raising READ_ONLY permission. Confirm the final config validates through real sp run preflight.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Specialist schema/validation test covers the READ_ONLY tool contract.
- [ ] sp run changelog-drafter --bead <audit-bead> passes pre-run validation in a fixture.
- [ ] No file outside the narrow config/test scope changes.

## OUTPUT
Root cause, changed fields/files, preflight evidence, and residual compatibility notes.
source.title: Fix changelog-drafter READ_ONLY capability validation
